shared.org: AIESEC in Zagazig — the #1 local committee in Egypt for incoming Global Volunteer (term 25.26). Our Customer Experience team holds the country's highest approved-to-completed conversion rate, so you're supported from the first message to the airport goodbye.
shared.locationNote: Zagazig is centrally located in Egypt — under an hour from many cities and close to both the Red and Mediterranean seas. It's a safe city where every key area is about ten minutes away.
shared.climate: Moderate climate — around 35°C in summer and 15°C in winter.

applicationProcess.title: Apply
applicationProcess.text: Pick this opportunity and apply on the official AIESEC platform. Five minutes, no perfect CV required.

applicationProcess.title: Interview
applicationProcess.text: A short conversation with our team to get to know you and confirm the fit.

applicationProcess.title: Get matched
applicationProcess.text: You're accepted and matched to the project and start dates that work for you.

applicationProcess.title: Prepare
applicationProcess.text: Visa support, accommodation and logistics — sorted together with your EP buddy.

applicationProcess.title: Volunteer
applicationProcess.text: Arrive to an airport pickup and make real impact, with trips and a Global Village along the way.

applicationProcess.title: Return
applicationProcess.text: Head home with a global certificate, a second family and a story that travels.

faqs.a: Young people roughly 18–30 from anywhere in the world. Most roles need no prior experience; some ask for a specific background, noted under Requirements.

faqs.q: Do I need to speak Arabic?
faqs.a: No. Projects run in English (B1 and up). Your team speaks English throughout and a few roles also welcome German or French speakers.
A small hosting (TN) fee covers your support, accommodation arrangement and experience. Your travel is separate; living costs in Zagazig are among the lowest in Egypt.
Yes — a safe, welcoming city where every key area is about ten minutes away, centrally located and close to the Red and Mediterranean seas.

faqs.q: Do you help with the visa?
faqs.a: Yes. Our experience team, ranked #1 in Egypt for incoming exchange, supports you through the visa process and every logistic.
Yes — a recognised global certificate on completion, plus outings and a Global Village celebration along the way.

opportunities.title: FBI
opportunities.short: Bring music and art to children at a local academy — and leave your fingerprint on a young generation.
opportunities.overview: FBI is part of AIESEC in Zagazig's Fingerprint project. You'll run creative music and art sessions for children, using the universal language of art to build their confidence, imagination and joy across six unforgettable weeks.
opportunities.orgAbout: You'll work with a children's learning academy in Zagazig, hosted and supported end-to-end by AIESEC in Zagazig's award-winning experience team.
responsibilities: Plan and deliver music and art activities for children
Create a fun, safe and inclusive classroom
Encourage creativity, teamwork and self-expression
Prepare simple materials and small performances
Share your own culture through art
requirements: A background or genuine passion in music or art
Female applicants preferred for this project
benefits: Covered accommodation for the whole stay
Outings and a Global Village celebration
opportunities.accommodation: Comfortable accommodation is arranged and covered by the hosting team for the full duration of the project.
opportunities.food: Some meals are provided; food in Zagazig is affordable and delicious, with vegetarian options widely available.
opportunities.transportation: Airport pickup on arrival, plus support getting around the city and to the project each day.

opportunities.title: HFNEWI
opportunities.short: Teach English and life skills to children at the Hefnawy academy, and become a role model that sticks.
opportunities.overview: Part of the Global Classroom project, HFNEWI places you inside a local academy where you'll help children learn English and grow in confidence through interactive, high-energy lessons.
opportunities.orgAbout: Hosted at the Hefnawy learning academy in Zagazig, with full support from AIESEC in Zagazig's experience team — ranked first in Egypt for incoming exchange.
responsibilities: Lead interactive English lessons for children
Design engaging activities, songs and games
Build kids' confidence and speaking skills
Bring your own culture into the classroom
Collaborate with the local teachers
requirements: Female applicants preferred for this project
opportunities.accommodation: Covered accommodation is arranged for your entire stay, close to the project and the city centre.
opportunities.food: Two meals a day are included, and food in Zagazig is cheap and delicious with vegetarian options available.
opportunities.transportation: Airport pickup on arrival, with daily support getting to and from the academy.

opportunities.title: Biotechnologie (Amen LAB)
opportunities.short: Assist a working biotech and pharmaceutical lab — hands-on exposure for future scientists and medics.
opportunities.overview: As part of the Heartbeat project, you'll support the team at Amen Lab, assisting with day-to-day laboratory and pharmaceutical work and gaining real exposure to Egypt's health-science field.
opportunities.orgAbout: Amen Lab is a biotechnology and pharmaceutical laboratory in Zagazig, hosting international volunteers through AIESEC in Zagazig.
responsibilities: Assist the lab team with daily tasks
Support sample preparation and basic procedures
Observe and learn clinical and lab workflows
Help maintain a clean, safe lab environment
Document and share what you learn
requirements: Female applicants preferred for this project
opportunities.accommodation: Covered accommodation is arranged for the full duration, within easy reach of the lab.
opportunities.food: Food in Zagazig is affordable and delicious, with vegetarian options widely available.
opportunities.transportation: Airport pickup on arrival, plus support getting to the lab and around the city.

opportunities.title: ENT
opportunities.short: Shadow and assist ENT specialists in a real clinical setting — built for medical students.
opportunities.overview: An intensive four-week Heartbeat placement where you support ENT (ear, nose and throat) practitioners — observing consultations and assisting under supervision in a real Egyptian clinic.
opportunities.orgAbout: A medical center in Zagazig specialising in ENT care, hosting volunteers through AIESEC in Zagazig.
responsibilities: Assist ENT doctors during consultations
Observe examinations and minor procedures
Help prepare patients and materials
Support basic clinical tasks under supervision
Learn medical workflows firsthand
requirements: Female applicants preferred for this project
opportunities.accommodation: Covered accommodation is arranged for your four-week placement, close to the clinic.
opportunities.food: One meal is covered; food in Zagazig is otherwise cheap and delicious with vegetarian options.
opportunities.transportation: Airport pickup on arrival, plus support getting to the clinic each day.

opportunities.title: On The Map
opportunities.location: Zagazig, Sharqia — Egypt (+ trips across Egypt)
opportunities.packages: Travel packages from $270 (4 weeks, 2 cities) or $395 (6 weeks, 6 cities).
opportunities.short: Tell Egypt's story through marketing and photography — while a travel package takes you across the country.
opportunities.overview: On The Map is AIESEC in Zagazig's flagship experience: create marketing content and photography for local partners while exploring up to six Egyptian cities on an optional travel package. No requirements — just curiosity and a camera.
opportunities.orgAbout: AIESEC in Zagazig hosts On The Map in partnership with local organizations, offering some of the most affordable travel packages in all of Egypt.
responsibilities: Create marketing content and social media
Shoot photography across projects and trips
Help tell the story of Zagazig and Egypt
Collaborate with the local team
Represent your culture at events
requirements: An eye for content or photography is a plus
benefits: Covered accommodation, plus hotels during trips
FREE trips across up to six cities
opportunities.accommodation: Accommodation is covered in Zagazig, with hotel stays provided during the trips on your travel package.
opportunities.food: Food is covered during trips; in Zagazig it's cheap and delicious with vegetarian options widely available.
opportunities.transportation: Transportation is covered during all trips, plus airport pickup and full visa support.
